 SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 Released: Direct Link to Download Response Sheet PDF at ssc.gov.in
 By Bebo Rani Last Updated: Nov 4, 2026, 18:37 IST SSC CGL Answer Key 2026: SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 has been released on November 4, 2026, on its official website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates who appeared in the Tier 1 CBT exam can now check their response sheet PDF given in this article.
 SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 Released: Direct Link to Download Response Sheet PDF at ssc.gov.in Key Points
 The SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 was released on November 4, 2026.
 Candidates can raise objections against the answer key from November 4 to 7, 2026.
 The Tier 1 exam was conducted in computer-based mode from Sep 30 to Oct 30, 2026.
 SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 on November 4, 2026, on ssc.gov.in. Candidates who appeared in the Combined Graduate Level Examination can now download the provisional answer key and their response sheet. The Tier 1 exam was held from 30 September to 30 October 2026 in computer-based mode. Using the answer key, candidates can match their responses with the correct answers and estimate their marks. SSC has also opened an objection window for candidates who find any error. The objection window is open from  November 4 to 7, 2026.  Check this article for the direct link, steps to download, marking scheme, and objection process.

 SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 Direct Link 
 SSC has released the SSC CGL Tier 1 answer key 2026 on its official website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates have to log in with their account details to see the provisional answer key and their response sheet. The link is now active only for a limited time, so candidates must download a copy as soon as it opens.  
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 
 Click Here 
 Steps to Download SSC CGL Tier 1 Answer Key 2026 
 Candidates can follow the steps below to download the SSC CGL provisional answer key and response sheet.  
 Go to the official website, ssc.gov.in. 
 On the home page, click on the "Answer Key" section. 
 Click on the SSC CGL Tier 1 2026 answer key link. 
 Log in with your registration number and password. 
 The provisional answer key and your response sheet will appear on the screen. 
 Check your answers against the answer key. 
 Download the PDF and take a printout for future use. 
 Details Mentioned on SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 
 The answer key and response sheet show the details below. Candidates should check each detail carefully before they calculate their marks or raise an objection. 
 Candidate's name 
 Roll number and registration number 
 Exam date and shift timing 
 Exam centre name and address 
 Section name (General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, English Comprehension) 
 Question ID for each question 
 Correct option as per the answer key 
 Option marked by the candidate 
 Status of each question (correct, wrong or not attempted)
